title: The Monday meeting
premise: In the Monday meeting Marcus offers to do the client deck with AI and gets laughed at and sent for coffee. Six months later the same room is in a panic, and this time they bring the coffee to him.

shots.image_prompt: close shot, chest up, a glass-walled meeting room with a long white table and a city view behind it, bright flat morning light, {tyler}, in a navy waistcoat over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up, leaning back in his chair with one hand tossed out toward the rest of the table, eyes still down on his laptop, mouth open mid-question, one eyebrow cocked, bored. Vertical composition, no text anywhere in the image.
shots.motion_prompt: Tyler tosses the question at the room without looking up, his mouth moving as he asks it, then he drums his fingers on the table and waits. Slow push-in on his bored face.
shots.speaker: tyler

shots.image_prompt: close shot, chest up, a glass-walled meeting room with a long white table and a city view behind it, bright flat morning light, {marcus}, in a wrinkled grey hoodie over a white tee with a blue office lanyard, half out of his chair and leaning over the table with one hand raised like a schoolboy, eyes wide and hopeful, mouth open mid-sentence, eyebrows up, a nervous eager smile. Vertical composition, no text anywhere in the image.
shots.motion_prompt: Marcus leans forward with his hand up, his mouth moving fast as he blurts it out, nodding hard to sell it. Quick push-in on his hopeful face.
shots.vo_line: I could do it with AI.
shots.speaker: marcus

shots.image_prompt: close shot, chest up, a glass-walled meeting room with a long white table and a city view behind it, bright flat morning light, {jess}, in a cream blazer over a black top, doubled over the table laughing with one hand slapped over her mouth and the other pointing off camera, eyes squeezed shut, tears at the corners, shoulders shaking. shots.image_prompt: close shot, chest up, a glass-walled meeting room with a long white table and a city view behind it, bright flat morning light, {tyler}, in a navy waistcoat over a white shirt with the sleeves rolled up, leaning forward on both elbows now and grinning wide at someone off camera, chin tipped up, eyes narrowed, mouth open mid-sentence. shots.motion_prompt: Tyler leans in on his elbows with a smirk, his mouth moving as he says it slowly and enjoys every word, then winks. Push-in on his grin.
shots.vo_line: That's cute, Marcus. Stick to the coffee run.

shots.motion_prompt: Tyler flicks the empty cup and it skids down the table and stops against Marcus's hand; Marcus's smile falls and Jess shakes with silent laughter. The camera tracks the cup along the table.
